$description: Grim's Squad Hub design tokens. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE (ADR-020) — the Tailwind theme in apps/web is generated from it and CI fails on drift. Contrast-tested pairs are in 07-design/accessibility.md; do not introduce a new foreground/background combination without computing its ratio first.

orange.$description: The ED orange. LARGE TEXT AND ACCENTS ONLY on dark surfaces — it fails WCAG AA for body text. See accessibility.md.

orangeBright.$description: The body-text-safe orange. Use this for any orange text below 24px/18.66px-bold.

orangeDim.$description: Borders, inactive states, decorative fills. NEVER text — it fails at every size.

cyanBright.$description: Link text at body size on raised panels, where the base cyan is marginal.

hostile.$description: Hostile, alerts, destructive. NEVER the sole signal — pair with an icon or label.

hostileBright.$description: Body-size hostile text. The base red is marginal below 24px.

success.$description: Success, and FRESH DATA (<24h). Always paired with an icon and a text label.

warning.$description: Warning, and AGING DATA (<7d). Always paired with an icon and a text label.

void.$description: Page background. Deep space, deliberately not pure black — pure black plus glow causes halation.

panelSunken.$description: Inset areas: code blocks, table stripes.

hairline.$description: Default panel edge. Decorative — never the sole indicator of a control's boundary.

focus.$description: Focus ring. Must be VISIBLE — 2px solid, 2px offset, never removed.

subtle.$description: Neutral separators inside dense data tables, where orange would be noisy.

primary.$description: Body text. The default for everything readable.

secondary.$description: Supporting text, labels, metadata. Passes AA on all surfaces.

dim.$description: DECORATIVE AND DISABLED ONLY. Fails AA for body text on every surface — never use it for information a member needs.

onAccent.$description: Text on a filled orange/cyan/green button. Dark-on-bright, which is how those colours become accessible.

fresh.$description: Data under 24 hours old. ALWAYS accompanied by an icon and the literal age (INV-004).

stale.$description: Data over 7 days old. Uses the brighter red so the most important warning is the most legible.

display.$description: Headings and large numerals. Squared-off and technical. NEVER body text — it is tiring to read at length.

mono.$description: Data tables, credits, coordinates, callsigns, system addresses.

xs.$description: 12px. Metadata only. Never for a value a member acts on.

xl.$description: 24px. WCAG 'large text' threshold — the relaxed 3:1 contrast rule starts here.

bold.$description: At >=18.66px, bold text qualifies as WCAG 'large text'.

tabularNums.$description: MANDATORY on every number in a table or a stat. Misaligned credit columns look amateurish instantly.

none.$description: The default. The ED aesthetic is angular.

glowOrange.$description: Decorative. Suppressed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion and the high-contrast theme.

scanline.$description: ~1.2% opacity. At this level it is texture, not pattern. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-contrast: more.

cornerCut.$description: Angular panel corners, in the spirit of the cockpit UI. Purely decorative — never used to convey state.

reducedMotion.$value: all durations collapse to instant; panel-draw, scanline, glow pulse and the boot sequence are removed entirely
reducedMotion.$description: prefers-reduced-motion is respected automatically, not behind a setting.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum interactive target. ~40% of traffic is phones, often mid-play-session on a second screen.

highContrast.$description: Raises every text token to >=7:1 (AAA), removes glow and scanline, thickens borders. Shipped, not optional.

colourBlindSafe.$description: Deuteranopia makes the standard orange/red distinction nearly invisible, and red/green is the BGS delta indicator. Swaps the semantic ramp to blue/orange and increases icon differentiation.
